Assistant source review against rendered BFP PDF page 1, OTHER DOCUMENTS matrix and Notes (1)-(3). The condition is supported: reports apply if the building/facilities/structures are required to install any or a combination of wet standpipe, automatic fire suppression, or automatic fire detection and alarm systems. Needs correction: FSCR is prepared and duly signed by the Engineer/Architect-of-Record AND his/her Fire Safety Practitioner. FSCCR forms part of as-built documents turned over by the contractor to the owner and is duly signed by the Contractor/Construction Manager AND his/her Fire Safety Practitioner; the note does not independently identify a sole preparer. FSMR is prepared by the building owner, his/her fire safety practitioner OR authorized representative, and duly signed by the Building Administrator AND his/her Fire Safety Practitioner during regular annual fire safety inspection. The reference incorrectly substitutes the administrator as preparer. Preserve matrix service associations: FSCR -> FSEC; FSCCR -> occupancy FSIC; FSMR -> new business without valid occupancy-stage FSIC and the two renewal columns. Do not imply every applicant submits all three reports together.
